Implemented SQL-backed feature pipelines and used pandas for exploratory analysis and feature engineering. Wrote complex SQL queries for cohort analysis and used pandas for data cleaning and feature creation, which improved model precision for targeted campaigns by 18%. Collaborated with product teams via Jira and maintained code in Git.
